en.howTo: Sing to steer. Each wall has a hole at its note in every octave: hit the note and fly through.
en.noLives: No lives: one crash ends the run. Score is the distance.
en.needsArcade: Pitch Runner needs the latest Arcade app to hear you sing. It can't use the microphone here (for example in Expo Go).
en.permissionDenied: Pitch Runner listens to your voice to steer. Audio never leaves your phone. Allow the microphone to play.
en.micError: The microphone could not start. Check that microphone access is allowed in Settings and no other app is using it.
en.shareMessage: I flew {d} m in Pitch Runner by singing. Same walls, can you go further?
